on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			every_country = {
				mod1440_ar_count = yes
				mod1440_h_record = yes
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					mod1440_ev_init = yes
					mod1440_tb_default = yes
				}
			}
			mod1440_pop_round = yes
		}
	}

		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				mod1440_ar_count = yes

					mod1440_st_list = yes
				}
				mod1440_h_cas_step = yes
				mod1440_nf_equip = yes
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { mod1440_nf_shown = 1 } }
					mod1440_nf_fill = yes
					mod1440_h_draw = yes
				}
				mod1440_rec_daily = yes
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { mod1440_tb_ver = 1 } } }
					mod1440_tb_default = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

				set_temp_variable = { ev_fam = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_kid = 19 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sa = 2 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_a = THIS }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_sb = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_b = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_so = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_o = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_p = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_x = 0 }
				set_temp_variable = { ev_n = 0 }
				FROM = {
					mod1440_ev_add = yes
				}
				if = {
					limit = { FROM = { check_variable = { mod1440_hn_air = 1 } } has_dlc = "By Blood Alone" }
					mod1440_hn_drop = yes
				}
				log = "MOD1440 listening: on_units_paradropped_in_state, state [THIS.GetName], by [FROM.GetName], [?hn_n] divisions honoured"
			}
		}
	}
	on_war_relation_added = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { is_ai = no }
				set_temp_variable = { wr_c = FROM }
				mod1440_ev_war_on = yes
			}
			if = {
				limit = { FROM = { is_ai = no } }
				FROM = {
					set_temp_variable = { wr_c = PREV }
					mod1440_ev_war_by = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
